title: Construction data for the normalized scalar Roos lift
statement: For a coefficient-derived scalar model and a strict Roos map f with zero shifted coordinate, there exists a scalar-extended strict Roos map h with zero shifted coordinate and the normalized quotient-coordinate formula.

proof.text: Restrict the normalized quotient-system scalar unit at each level. The completed coefficient residue square makes these maps linear over the completed source ring. Transpose using the ordinary sheaf scalar adjunction to obtain a scalar comparison natural in both the module and the quotient index. Its tensor formula follows from the normalized units and linearity.

The chain-map identity for f, composed with the shifted-product projection, shows that its first coordinate is killed by the Roos boundary because the shifted coordinate vanishes. Hence the first-coordinate quotient family is strictly compatible. Apply ordinary scalar extension and the levelwise comparison; naturality preserves this compatibility.

Take the product of the extended quotient coordinates. Compatibility kills the Roos boundary, so mappingCocone.lift with zero shifted cochain supplies h. The lift projection identities prove its shifted coordinate vanishes. Tensor naturality and the levelwise tensor formula give the required quotient-coordinate identity.

proof_origin.place: Direct ordinary scalar-adjunction construction of the compatible quotient family; Mathlib mappingCocone.lift

lean.statement:
theorem scalarModelRoosZeroLift_core
    (SL : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l L X)
    (ρL : IntegralComparisonRoosModel l L X)
    (ρF : IntegralComparisonRoosModel l F X)
    (b : IntegralComparisonScalarModel l L F j X SL ρF)
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E X).FullSubcategory)
    (D : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l L X) ℤ)
    (f : (completedOrdinaryScalarComplex l E L ι X).obj P.obj ⟶ integralOperationsRoos
      (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l L X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj D).asFunctor)
    (hf : ∀ i : ℤ, f.f i ≫
      (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd (scalarRoosBoundary
        (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l L X).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj D).asFunctor)).v i (i - 1) (by omega) = 0) :
    ∃ h : scalarModelRoosZeroLiftType l E L F ι j X SL P D,
      scalarModelRoosZeroLiftZero l E L F ι j X SL P D h ∧
      scalarModelRoosZeroLiftCoordinates l E L F ι j X SL P D f h
